Players Committee high-resolution card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/jedilightsaber_ai.png</code> in the PC's Holotable repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6d0875f78ed268d138f6b4466a46654409fc6353 6d0875f] (20 February 2025, “More AIs for GEMP Series 7”), uploaded unchanged. No card-size GIF of this image was committed. Used on the version pages of the card (ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026).
